resources.string: Choose where to start. Each app can use Direct, VPN, or DPI within one Detour connection.
Bypass throttling without a VPN server. Results depend on your network.
Paste a vless:// key from your provider.
Add your provider’s HTTPS subscription URL.
Import a configuration file or paste an Amnezia key.
Add or import a profile, then select it.
Assign DPI to the apps that need it.
Assign VPN to the apps that need it.
Tap Connect when ready. Android will ask for VPN permission. Detour cannot run alongside another VPN.
Some apps already use VPN. Select a VPN profile or assign them Direct.
Connected. You are ready to go.
Could not finish setup. Try again.
Select a profile, then tap Continue.
Choose a profile and app routes step by step. Opening setup keeps your current settings.
